name: readSingleNormalCharacter
expected: Returns 'a' (97), updates lastChar to 'a', and lineCounter remains 0 because it is not a newline character.

name: readCarriageReturnIncrementsLineCounter
expected: Returns '\r' (13), increments lineCounter from 0 to 1, and updates lastChar to '\r'.

name: readNewlineAfterCarriageReturnDoesNotIncrementLineCounter
expected: First read() returns '\r' and increments lineCounter to 1 (lastChar='\r'). Second read() returns '\n' but does NOT increment lineCounter because lastChar is '\r'.

name: readStandaloneNewlineIncrementsLineCounter
expected: Returns '\n' (10), increments lineCounter from 0 to 1 because lastChar (UNDEFINED / -2) is not '\r'.

name: readEndOfStreamReturnsMinusOne
expected: Returns END_OF_STREAM (-1), updates lastChar to -1, and lineCounter remains 0.

name: readMultipleLinesWithMixedNewlines
expected: Sequence of reads correctly tracks lineCounter: 'a'->0, '\n'->1, 'b'->1, '\r'->2, 'c'->2, '\r'->3, '\n'->3 (ignored due to preceding \r), 'd'->3.

name: readConsecutiveCarriageReturns
expected: First '\r' increments lineCounter to 1 (lastChar=\r). Second '\r' increments lineCounter to 2 (lastChar=\r).

name: readAfterEndOfStreamMaintainsLastChar
expected: Reading 'a' returns 'a', reading again returns -1 (END_OF_STREAM) and sets lastChar to -1.

name: readAfterCarriageReturnFollowedByNormalChar
expected: First read '\r' increments lineCounter to 1 (lastChar='\r'). Second read 'x' does not increment lineCounter, but updates lastChar to 'x'.
